name: Temair

attributes.attribute: another name for the Irish hill site of Tara
the royal hill of the high kings of Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Temair is another name for Tara. It also appears as Temuir. See the entry for Tara for the details. Temair was the royal hill of the high kings of Ireland.

okr.objective: Describe Temair as a name for Tara.
key_results: Temair, also written Temir, is an alternate name for Tara.
The entry for Tara gives the full record of the royal hill of Ireland's high kings.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
